stories.title: Manitoba urged to continue work on wildfire response after devastating 2025 season
stories.summary: A new report examined how Manitoba can improve its wildfire response, after millions of hectares burned in the summer of 2025.

stories.title: Vilardi nets hat trick as Winnipeg Jets cap homestand with 4-2 win over Mammoth
stories.summary: Gabriel Vilardi completed his second career hat trick into an empty net while Stuart Skinner made 34 saves as the Mammoth outshot the Jets 36-15.

stories.title: Lions coach Pierce signs extension through 2029
Manitoba solar panel project could create 8,000 jobs, First Nations group says
stories.summary: A new solar panel manufacturing facility may soon come to Manitoba, following a memorandum of understanding between the Southern Chiefs Organization and RCT Solutions.

stories.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers sign linebacker Jacob Roberts to one-year contract
stories.summary: The Winnipeg Blue Bombers signed Jacob Roberts, the six-foot-one, 233-pound American linebacker to a one-year contract Monday.

stories.title: Winnipeg police required to note race in use-of-force reports
stories.summary: The Winnipeg Police Service has historically kept track of some race information but, as of last month, officers must include it in reports when force has been used in a case.

stories.title: Scheifele sets franchise goals record as Winnipeg Jets fall to Vegas 5-4 in a shootout
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele scored his 380th career goal to pass his mentor Dale Hawerchuk but it was not enough as the Jets could not hold onto a third period lead against Vegas.

stories.title: 25 new prosecutors half to what is needed to make ‘meaningful change’ on Manitoba Crown workloads
stories.summary: The provincial government is adding several Crowns over three and a half years, but one attorney says it's still far off from meaningful change.

stories.title: Manitoba health minister concerned about U.S. measles cases
stories.summary: As health officials praise Canada for moving in the right direction to combat measles, they're also warning of concerning trends in other countries.

stories.title: Woman accused of murder in death of 70-year-old man in Winnipeg
stories.summary: A 43-year-old woman is facing a second-degree murder charge in relation to the Oct. 20 death of 70-year-old Richard James Boychuk.
